id: lms-sekolah

title.id: LMS Sekolah — Platform Tata Kelola Sekolah Terpadu & CBT Online
title.en: School LMS — Integrated School Management Platform & Online CBT

summary.id: Platform komprehensif Learning Management System (LMS) dan tata kelola operasional sekolah terpadu dengan 29 modul fungsional, 9 tingkat hak akses (role), ujian daring (CBT), e-rapor, dan portal multi-pengguna yang telah aktif beroperasi secara live.
summary.en: Comprehensive enterprise School Learning Management System (LMS) and academic ERP featuring 29 functional modules, 9 RBAC user roles, Computer-Based Testing (CBT), digital report cards, and integrated portals live in production.

challenge.id: Banyak institusi pendidikan menghadapi kendala fragmentasi operasional: pencatatan absensi manual, pelaksanaan ujian daring yang rentan kendala koneksi dan kecurangan, tagihan SPP yang sulit direkonsiliasi, serta keterlambatan distribusi nilai akademik ke orang tua.
challenge.en: Educational institutions faced operational fragmentation: manual paper attendance, vulnerable online exam platforms, complicated tuition reconciliations, and delayed grade report communication to parents.

solution.id: Merancang arsitektur web modern berbasis Skeleton CMS Standard, backend asynchronous berkinerja tinggi FastAPI + PostgreSQL, caching Redis untuk sesi ujian CBT ribuan siswa serentak, serta antarmuka multi-portal responsif untuk Guru, Siswa, dan Orang Tua.
solution.en: Architected a modern multi-portal web platform on Skeleton CMS Standard, high-throughput asynchronous FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend, Redis cache for high-concurrency CBT sessions, and responsive portals for Teachers, Students, and Parents.

id: Telah berhasil di-deploy dan beroperasi live di https://lms.limoriatech.com/
Otomatisasi 29 modul fungsional memangkas beban administrasi akademik hingga 70%
Engine CBT mampu menangani ribuan sesi ujian siswa secara bersamaan tanpa kendala performa
Transparansi presensi kehadiran, nilai, dan tagihan SPP yang dapat dipantau langsung oleh wali murid
en: Live and fully operational in production at https://lms.limoriatech.com/
29 automated functional modules cutting academic administrative workload by 70%
High-concurrency CBT engine handling thousands of simultaneous student exam sessions
Real-time attendance, grade reports, and tuition payment tracking for parents

id: restoqr

title.id: RestoQR — Smart Dine-in & Food Ordering Platform Terpadu
title.en: RestoQR — Integrated Smart Dine-in & Food Ordering Platform

client.id: Industri F&B, Jaringan Restoran & Kafe Modern
client.en: F&B Industry, Modern Restaurant Chains & Cafes

summary.id: Platform web terpadu enterprise untuk pemesanan makanan mandiri berbasis QR Code di meja restoran, Kitchen Display System (KDS) dengan aging timer audio, POS Kasir & Billing Terminal dengan floor plan visual, cetak struk ESC/POS, serta Backoffice CMS manajemen operasional restoran.
summary.en: Enterprise integrated smart dine-in platform featuring QR Code self-ordering PWA, real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS) with audio chimes and aging timers, interactive POS cashier floor plan terminal with ESC/POS thermal printing, and comprehensive backoffice CMS.

challenge.id: Operasional restoran di jam sibuk kerap mengalami antrean pesanan yang panjang, kesalahan pencatatan pesanan manual oleh pramusaji, keterlambatan koordinasi antara kasir dan dapur, serta kesulitan kalkulasi split bill dan rekonsiliasi kasir harian.
challenge.en: Peak-hour restaurant operations frequently suffered from long waiter order queues, manual miscommunication between front-of-house and kitchen, delayed ticket fulfillment, and complex split billing and shift cash reconciliations.

solution.id: Membangun ekosistem 4 antarmuka terintegrasi: Customer Mobile Web (PWA Self-Ordering), Kitchen Display System (KDS) full-screen dark mode dengan aging timer 3 warna dan Web Audio API, POS Kasir dengan denah meja interaktif dan cetak struk ESC/POS, serta Backoffice CMS dengan analitik penjualan dan audit trail.
solution.en: Engineered a unified 4-client ecosystem: Customer Mobile Web (PWA Self-Ordering), Kitchen Display System (KDS) in full-screen dark UI with 3-tier aging timers and Web Audio API alerts, POS Billing Terminal with interactive table floor plan and ESC/POS thermal receipt printing, and Backoffice CMS with sales analytics and audit logs.

id: Mendukung 4 antarmuka khusus: Customer PWA, Kitchen Display (KDS), POS Kasir, dan Backoffice CMS
Mempercepat waktu pemesanan tamu hingga 60% tanpa perlu menunggu pramusaji datang
Aging timer 3 warna (Hijau, Kuning, Merah) pada KDS menekan angka keterlambatan masakan di dapur hingga 85%
Dukungan multi-metode pembayaran (Cash, EDC, QRIS Dinamis) dengan fitur Split Bill rata maupun per item
Integrasi cetak struk thermal ESC/POS 58mm/80mm dan laporan penutupan shift kasir (Z-Report)
en: Features 4 dedicated interfaces: Customer PWA, Kitchen Display (KDS), POS Cashier, and Backoffice CMS
Accelerates guest ordering speed by 60% with instant QR code self-service without waiter delays
3-tier visual aging timer (Green, Yellow, Red) on KDS reduces kitchen preparation delays by 85%
Multi-method payment support (Cash, EDC, Dynamic QRIS) with equal and per-item split billing capabilities
Integrated 58mm/80mm ESC/POS thermal receipt printing and automated cashier shift Z-Reports

summary.id: Implementasi sistem ERP terintegrasi untuk mengelola supply chain, inventory, dan akuntansi di 14 pabrik dan gudang.
summary.en: Implementation of an integrated ERP system to manage supply chain, inventory, and enterprise accounting across 14 manufacturing plants and distribution warehouses.

challenge.id: Sistem lama terfragmentasi sehingga rekonsiliasi data stok dan laporan keuangan memakan waktu hingga 2 minggu setiap akhir bulan.
challenge.en: Legacy siloed systems caused monthly inventory reconciliation and financial reporting to take over 2 weeks.

solution.id: Membangun sistem ERP terpusat dengan sinkronisasi data real-time, integrasi barcode scanner gudang, dan dashboard analitik eksekutif.
solution.en: Engineered a centralized ERP platform with real-time data sync, warehouse barcode scanner integration, and executive business intelligence dashboards.

id: Mengurangi waktu rekonsiliasi laporan keuangan bulanan dari 14 hari menjadi 1 hari
Akurasi stok pergudangan meningkat menjadi 99.4%
Efisiensi biaya operasional inventaris hingga 28%
en: Reduced monthly financial reconciliation cycle from 14 days to 1 day
Warehouse inventory accuracy surged to 99.4%
Achieved a 28% operational expenditure efficiency in logistics

title.en: Mobile Field Operations & Field Reporting App

summary.id: Aplikasi mobile offline-first untuk 500+ kurir dan surveyor lapangan di berbagai wilayah pelosok Indonesia.
summary.en: Offline-first mobile application empowering 500+ couriers and field surveyors across remote regions of Indonesia.

challenge.id: Area kerja lapangan sering kehilangan koneksi internet (blind spot), menyebabkan data penyerahan barang tertunda atau hilang.
challenge.en: Remote working areas often encountered cellular blackouts, causing delayed or lost proof-of-delivery data.

solution.id: Merancang aplikasi mobile dengan sistem local SQLite database, auto-sync queue saat terdeteksi koneksi, dan geotagging terverifikasi.
solution.en: Designed a mobile app with local SQLite storage, background auto-sync queues upon connection restoration, and verified GPS geotagging.

id: Peningkatan 45% kecepatan update status pengiriman ke pelanggan
Zero data loss berkat mekanisme offline-sync otomatis
Tingkat kepuasan kurir lapangan 4.8 / 5.0
en: 45% faster delivery status notifications to end customers
Zero data loss via resilient automated offline-first synchronization
Courier field satisfaction rating reached 4.8 / 5.0

summary.id: Pengembangan middleware API terintegrasi yang menghubungkan sistem core banking dengan payment gateway dan e-wallet.
summary.en: High-throughput API middleware bridging core banking ledgers with external payment gateways and digital e-wallets.

challenge.id: Lonjakan transaksi saat flash sale sering menyebabkan timeout dan ketidaksinkronan saldo akun pengguna.
challenge.en: High-concurrency flash sale traffic surges frequently caused transactional timeouts and balance synchronization lags.

solution.id: Arsitektur microservices berbasis event-driven dengan Apache Kafka, Redis caching layer, dan otomatisasi rate limiting.
solution.en: Event-driven microservices architecture utilizing Apache Kafka message queues, Redis caching, and dynamic token-bucket rate limiting.

id: Mampu memproses hingga 8.500 transaksi per detik dengan latensi rata-rata < 120ms
Availability uptime tercapai di angka 99.98%
Kepatuhan penuh terhadap standar regulasi keamanan transaksi finansial
en: Sustains up to 8,500 transactions per second with average latency < 120ms
High availability uptime sustained at 99.98%
Full compliance with strict financial industry security standards

id: aplikasi-kasir-ai

title.id: Aplikasi Kasir AI — Point of Sale Cerdas Berbasis Kecerdasan Buatan
title.en: Kasir AI — AI-Powered Smart Point of Sale Application

summary.id: Platform Point of Sale (POS) berbasis AI terintegrasi dengan modul kasir mobile, admin dashboard analitik penjualan real-time, manajemen produk, laporan shift, dan terminal POS multi-pembayaran (Cash, QRIS, EDC) yang dirancang untuk bisnis ritel dan F&B modern.
summary.en: AI-integrated Point of Sale (POS) platform featuring mobile cashier module, real-time sales analytics admin dashboard, product management, shift reports, and multi-payment terminal (Cash, QRIS, EDC) designed for modern retail and F&B businesses.

challenge.id: Bisnis ritel dan F&B skala kecil-menengah kesulitan mendapatkan sistem kasir yang cerdas, terjangkau, dan mampu memberikan insight penjualan real-time tanpa memerlukan keahlian teknis untuk operasionalnya.
challenge.en: Small to mid-sized retail and F&B businesses struggled to find smart, affordable POS systems that deliver real-time sales insights without requiring technical expertise to operate.

solution.id: Membangun ekosistem POS terpadu dengan antarmuka kasir mobile (React + Vite), backend FastAPI berkinerja tinggi, caching Redis untuk transaksi concurrent, serta modul AI analytics yang memberikan rekomendasi stok dan tren penjualan otomatis.
solution.en: Built an integrated POS ecosystem with mobile cashier UI (React + Vite), high-performance FastAPI backend, Redis caching for concurrent transactions, and an AI analytics module providing automated stock recommendations and sales trend insights.

id: Autentikasi JWT HTTP-only Cookie yang kebal terhadap serangan XSS
Manajemen role & permission granular berbasis resource & action (RBAC)
Audit trail otomatis setiap aktivitas mutasi data transaksi
Modul master data dengan pola Split-Pane responsif untuk efisiensi operasional
Dukungan multi-metode pembayaran: Cash, QRIS Dinamis, dan EDC
en: JWT HTTP-only Cookie authentication immune to XSS attacks
Granular role & permission management per resource & action (RBAC)
Automatic audit trail for every transaction data mutation
Master data module with responsive Split-Pane pattern for operational efficiency
Multi-payment method support: Cash, Dynamic QRIS, and EDC

id: event-eo-ai

title.id: Platform EO Digital — Manajemen Event Organizer Terpadu
title.en: EO Digital Platform — Integrated Event Organizer Management System

summary.id: Platform terpadu Event Organizer (EO) modern yang mencakup Website Publik interaktif untuk calon klien serta CMS Backoffice Admin Panel yang komprehensif untuk mengelola pemesanan acara, paket layanan, portofolio event, artikel blog, master data, RBAC, dan audit trail.
summary.en: Modern integrated Event Organizer (EO) platform featuring an interactive public website for potential clients and a comprehensive CMS backoffice admin panel for managing event bookings, service packages, event portfolio, blog articles, master data, RBAC, and audit trails.

challenge.id: Tim EO mengelola pemesanan acara, paket layanan, dan portofolio event secara terpisah menggunakan spreadsheet dan WhatsApp, menyebabkan lambatnya respons klien, kehilangan prospek, dan tidak adanya visibilitas pipeline bisnis secara real-time.
challenge.en: EO teams managed event bookings, service packages, and event portfolios separately using spreadsheets and WhatsApp, causing slow client responses, lost leads, and no real-time business pipeline visibility.

solution.id: Membangun platform dua sisi: Website Publik responsif untuk prospek klien dengan fitur booking online, katalog paket, galeri portofolio, dan artikel blog; serta CMS Backoffice lengkap dengan manajemen booking pipeline, kelola paket event bertingkat (Draft/Final), audit trail, dan dukungan multi-tema (Light/Dark Mode + 5 warna aksen).
solution.en: Engineered a dual-sided platform: a responsive Public Website for client prospects with online booking, package catalog, portfolio gallery, and blog; and a full CMS Backoffice with booking pipeline management, tiered event package management (Draft/Final validation), audit trail, and multi-theme support (Light/Dark Mode + 5 accent colors).

id: Website publik lengkap dengan katalog layanan, paket harga, galeri portofolio, dan formulir booking online
Manajemen booking pipeline 4-status: Baru, Dihubungi, Deal, Batal — dengan follow-up WhatsApp otomatis
Validasi formulir bertingkat Draft vs Final dengan auto-switch tab dan Sticky Bottom Action Bar
Audit trail real-time: setiap mutasi data tercatat dengan stempel waktu, pengguna, dan IP address
Dukungan penuh Light Mode, Dark Mode, dan 5 pilihan warna aksen kustomisasi
en: Complete public website with service catalog, pricing packages, portfolio gallery, and online booking form
4-status booking pipeline: New, Contacted, Deal, Cancelled — with automated WhatsApp follow-up
Tiered form validation Draft vs Final with auto-switch tab and Sticky Bottom Action Bar
Real-time audit trail: every data mutation recorded with timestamp, user, and IP address
Full Light Mode, Dark Mode, and 5 accent color customization options

id: kasir-ai-mobile

title.id: Kasir AI Mobile — Aplikasi POS Lengkap untuk Android & iOS
title.en: Kasir AI Mobile — Full-Featured POS App for Android & iOS

summary.id: Aplikasi kasir mobile cross-platform (Android & iOS) berbasis Flutter dengan 20+ layar fungsional, mencakup transaksi penjualan & pembelian, scan barcode, manajemen stok, laporan bisnis real-time, cetak struk Bluetooth, sinkronisasi data, serta dukungan multi-metode pembayaran (Cash, QRIS, Transfer, Debit, Kredit, E-Wallet).
summary.en: Cross-platform Flutter POS mobile application (Android & iOS) with 20+ functional screens covering sales & purchase transactions, barcode scanning, inventory management, real-time business reports, Bluetooth receipt printing, data synchronization, and multi-payment method support (Cash, QRIS, Transfer, Debit, Credit, E-Wallet).

challenge.id: Pelaku usaha ritel dan F&B skala kecil-menengah membutuhkan solusi kasir mobile yang handal, dapat beroperasi secara offline, mudah digunakan tanpa pelatihan teknis, dan mampu memberikan laporan bisnis yang akurat kapan saja — tanpa bergantung pada perangkat PC atau laptop.
challenge.en: Small to mid-sized retail and F&B businesses needed a reliable mobile POS that works offline, is easy to operate without technical training, and delivers accurate business reports on the go — without depending on a PC or laptop.

solution.id: Membangun aplikasi Flutter cross-platform dengan arsitektur clean MVVM + Provider, database lokal SQLite (sqflite) untuk operasi offline-first, sinkronisasi data ke server via Dio, scanner barcode terintegrasi (mobile_scanner), cetak struk via Bluetooth printer ESC/POS, serta sistem laporan lengkap: Penjualan, Pembelian, Produk Terlaris, Stok, dan Laba Rugi.
solution.en: Built a cross-platform Flutter app using clean MVVM + Provider architecture, local SQLite database (sqflite) for offline-first operations, server data sync via Dio, integrated barcode scanning (mobile_scanner), Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal receipt printing, and comprehensive reporting: Sales, Purchase, Top Products, Inventory, and Profit & Loss.

Barcode product scanning directly from the camera for fast transaction input

id: black-auto-rental

title.id: Black Auto Rental — Platform Reservasi Armada & Sewa Mobil Wisata Terpadu
title.en: Black Auto Rental — Integrated Car Rental & Fleet Booking Platform

client.id: CV. Black Auto Rental / Industri Transportasi & Pariwisata
client.en: CV. Black Auto Rental / Transportation & Tourism

summary.id: Platform web Single Page Application (SPA) komprehensif untuk operasional rental mobil, penjemputan bandara, kos putri, dan penginapan harian terpadu. Dilengkapi katalog armada interaktif (Avanza, Innova Reborn, Brio, Jazz, Hiace, Xpander), integrasi reservasi instan via direct WhatsApp booking, galeri dokumentasi operasional, slider ulasan testimoni pelanggan, serta peta lokasi pool armada multi-cabang (Pariaman, Bandara BIM, dan Kota Padang).
summary.en: Comprehensive Single Page Application (SPA) web platform for car rental fleet operations, airport transfers, and guest lodging services. Features an interactive vehicle catalog (Avanza, Innova Reborn, Brio, Jazz, Hiace, Xpander), one-click direct WhatsApp booking integration, operational service gallery, customer review testimonial carousel, and multi-branch fleet pool location mapping (Pariaman, Minangkabau Airport, and Padang).

challenge.id: Penyedia jasa rental mobil lokal menghadapi tantangan dalam menampilkan ketersediaan dan spesifikasi teknis armada secara transparan kepada calon penyewa dari luar kota yang membutuhkan penjemputan cepat di Bandara Internasional Minangkabau (BIM), koordinasi pemesanan manual lewat telepon yang rentan miskomunikasi, serta kebutuhan katalog mobile-first yang sangat ringan dan cepat diakses wisatawan.
challenge.en: Local car rental operators faced challenges in presenting fleet transparency, vehicle specs, and instant pricing to out-of-town travelers needing rapid airport pickups at Minangkabau International Airport (BIM), manual reservation handling via telephone, and the urgent need for a lightweight mobile-first catalog accessible on the go.

solution.id: Merancang aplikasi web SPA berbasis AngularJS dengan routing HTML5 mode yang bersih, arsitektur data JSON dinamis yang memisahkan spesifikasi kapasitas mesin (cc), jumlah kursi, transmisi, dan tarif sewa per hari, sistem pemesanan direct WhatsApp dengan auto-filled template pesan, galeri dokumentasi armada, serta integrasi Google Maps interaktif untuk navigasi pool kendaraan.
solution.en: Architected an AngularJS SPA web platform featuring clean HTML5 mode URL routing, dynamic JSON data layer separating vehicle specs (engine cc, seating capacity, transmission, and daily rates), one-click direct WhatsApp booking with auto-populated booking templates, high-resolution fleet service gallery, and interactive Google Maps integration for fleet pool navigation.

id: Katalog armada interaktif memuat 10+ varian kendaraan lengkap dengan spesifikasi teknis dan transparansi harga
Integrasi direct WhatsApp booking memangkas alur pemesanan pelanggan menjadi kurang dari 1 menit
Dukungan multi-lokasi penjemputan strategis: Bandara Internasional Minangkabau (BIM), Kota Padang, dan Pariaman
Arsitektur SPA yang ringan dan cepat dibuka di perangkat mobile dengan performa responsif
